summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/model_routing.py

src/agent_runtime/model_routing.py

Python · Tier A

Own revisioned Main/Helper/Vision connections and call-type assignments in shared Settings authority. Capture detached task snapshots with opaque credential references, resolve generation presets at save time and construct role-isolated clients. Public updates reject stale revisions; accepted work retains its connection and credential version while new work captures current settings.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
reject_public_overrides 55 Reject model/endpoint/credential/routing fields and reserved generation prefixes at the public payload root or its immediate context map. Return other payloads unchanged; internal acceptance paths install routing snapshots separately.
Generation 101 Validate one role's saved generation profile, optional overrides, output/context allowances and timeout/recovery policy. Strict numeric/boolean types and bounds keep the accepted configuration usable; provider-specific override validation is delegated to model_configuration.
Generation.valid_recovery_deadline 120 Permit zero for an unlimited recovery deadline or at least thirty seconds; reject a positive deadline below that floor.
Generation.valid_overrides 129 Validate the role's explicit generation parameter map through the shared supported-override contract before it can enter a saved snapshot.
ModelConnection 137 Represent a role's endpoint/model, opaque credential version, optional managed-instance binding and generation policy. Secret values are resolved separately when constructing a physical client.
ModelConnection.valid_endpoint 151 Check the endpoint with the shared URL validator, reject embedded username/password credentials and remove trailing slashes. Credential material belongs in the write-only API- key field.
Route 164 Choose Main, Helper or Vision for one registered call type, with an independent allowance for one-way fallback from a configured auxiliary role to Main.
defaults 172 Build a fresh complete routing map from all registered call types and their declared default roles; fallback is enabled by the Route default.
RoutingConfiguration 178 Validate revisioned Main and optional Helper/Vision assignments with the exact call-type map. Accepted tasks retain detached copies instead of consulting live defaults for every call.
RoutingConfiguration.migrate_v1 192 Copy version-one settings/snapshots, add an unconfigured Vision role and default only the two new Vision routes. Existing role connections and route choices retain their values.
RoutingConfiguration.exact_catalog 208 Require every registered call type exactly once and reject unknown routing keys.
ConnectionUpdate 217 Accept a replacement role card, optional write-only key and explicit managed-detach intent. Omitting the key preserves its previous reference; generation defaults fill omitted generation settings.
RoutingUpdate 228 Carry an expected global revision and selectively supplied role cards or route edits. Omitted roles remain unchanged; explicit null removes an assignment, including Main.
ModelRoutingService 242 Own the shared Settings routing configuration and credential versions, capture detached task snapshots and construct role-isolated native clients. Saves also invalidate discovery/compatibility caches for edited roles; runtime routing and transport retries belong to llm.router.
ModelRoutingService.credential 319 Resolve an exact captured credential reference or fail if it no longer exists; never substitute a newer role key into accepted work.
ModelRoutingService.publish_change 361 Notify readers after the complete configuration transaction commits.
ModelRoutingService.output_floor_patch 373 Prepare, without writing, a revisioned routing update that raises the selected agent-decision connection's maximum output allowance when required by compiler policy. An unconfigured selected Helper uses Main for this compatibility projection; actual routing still enforces its fallback rule.
ModelRoutingService.capture 412 Read and validate the complete configuration under the shared lock and return a detached JSON-compatible snapshot, including opaque references but no credential values.
ModelRoutingService.require_main 418 Admission requires Main even when an auxiliary decision route is selected.
ModelRoutingService.public 430 Project safe editor state: replace credential references with presence/status, expose parameter/default/recommendation metadata and calculate configured effective destinations. Missing strict Helper destinations are shown as unavailable.
ModelRoutingService.update 531 Require the loaded revision, merge supplied route edits and replace only supplied role cards. Preserve a managed binding for same-endpoint/model generation edits, reject managed-key changes unless explicitly detached, validate output policy, increment revision and refresh edited-role caches. Notify Inference management after saving; accepted snapshots remain detached.
ModelRoutingService.bind_managed 651 Replace one role with a managed connection and new credential version, optionally requiring an expected revision. Resolve its generation settings, increment configuration revision and refresh the role's discovery/compatibility state.
ModelRoutingService.restore_embedding_connection 676 Restore only the embedding binding still owned by this activation.
ModelRoutingService.detach_managed 689 Clear managed-instance/binding identities while retaining the role's endpoint, model and credential. Honor an optional expected revision and publish a new configuration revision.
ModelRoutingService.client 706 Construct a physical native client from a validated captured role and its exact credential version. Apply composer thinking/output choices only when supplied by the execution caller, namespace compatibility by role and attach shared guidance/cache owners. Client construction does not select a different route.
ModelRoutingService.diagnostic_target 760 Capture one explicitly requested role for a bounded diagnostic without fallback. Reject an unconfigured role and defer physical-client construction to the check, preserving its saved generation/context limits and managed identity.
ModelRoutingService.install 793 Register safe configuration GET, revision-checked PUT, per-role model discovery and explicit diagnostics under the existing application authentication boundary.
capture_context 906 Install a routing snapshot only for internal task acceptance, retaining an existing snapshot unless fresh=True. Project selected connection/generation fields into legacy context for downstream consumers; the full routes and fallback policy remain authoritative in RoutingLLMClient.
